message.ai.approve.model: Approve this model for the tenant catalog? Tenants in the selected domains will be able to deploy it.
message.ai.delete.deployment: Delete this endpoint? Its replicas are removed and its base URL stops answering. API keys scoped to it will be refused.
message.ai.delete.generation.profile: Delete this generation profile? Any scope it is assigned to falls back to the level above it.
message.ai.delete.serving.profile: Delete this serving profile? Deployments using it keep running until their next change, then fall back to the platform default.
message.ai.drain.node: Drain this node? Its replicas move to other hosts and the node VM is destroyed, not stopped — a stopped node would keep its GPUs allocated.
message.ai.promote.rollout: Send all traffic to the candidate colour? The colour serving now is retired once the candidate is live.
message.ai.rollback.rollout: Send all traffic back to the colour serving now? The candidate keeps running until you delete it.
